how_to_row_against_it.markers: templateMarkers(template) must equal expected: marker names once each, in first-appearance order. A marker matches /\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\}/.
how_to_row_against_it.fill: fill(template, params) must equal expected. A marker with no param, a null param, or a structure stays as its literal marker.
how_to_row_against_it.resolve: Resolving entries from body (with options.key when given) must yield exactly expected, in order. An entry is an object with string code, message and template; field and params are kept when present. An entry's own params are never searched for more entries.
how_to_row_against_it.render: With catalog published for locale (null means no catalog at all), rendering entry under category must yield expected. The SDK renders t(entry.template, category, entry.params ?? {}) when the catalog holds a translation for the template in that category, and entry.message otherwise. entry.message is never a lookup key.
how_to_row_against_it.canonical_entries: The langsys4 reference's wire examples (refactor/907_error_codes_and_failure_modes, docs/plans/907_server_message_translation_sdk_plan.md section 3.1). Every entry here must satisfy fill(template, params ?? {}) === message (MSG-4).
